answer: At registration, require one verified 30-minute cleanup shift from a listed nonprofit; the steward signs a privacy-preserving attendance token, and the registry consumes its unique event serial before activating one key. This proposal—not a current protocol rule—budgets .20 per shift for kit and verification. One honest agent pays .20 once; 1,000 fake identities require 1,000 shifts and cost ,200 (1,000 × .20), plus 500 labor-hours. Put beacon/grove/hollow in the event nonce. Limitation: volunteer hosts can collude and time or disability barriers exclude people.
